title: English Conversation 22:  The Surprise Party
content: 1. to fake it: to pretend - I hate my job, but I fake it when I am work. - If you don't like your boss, you shouldn't show it. You should just fake it. 2. accidentally: not on purpose; by mistake - He accidentally dropped his phone in the toilet. - She accidentally hit me. 3. to be a great actress: a woman who is very good at acting - She is a great actress. - Mary doesn't like them. She is just pretending. She is a great actress.
